title: Lower the Bar
pin_title: ADHD Seasonal Energy: Lower the Bar When Daylight Shrinks
description: Shorter days often reduce available energy for an ADHD brain. Instead of keeping the same standards, deliberately lower the daily bar: fewer tasks, more recovery, earlier wind-down. Adjusting the expectation is not failure. It is accurate planning for the season. #ADHD #SelfCompassion #Seasonal #ADHDLife

title: Stock Is Healthy
pin_title: ADHD Planning: Keep a Visible Buffer of Ready Tasks
description: Running out of ready tasks creates last-minute pressure for an ADHD week. Keeping a small buffer of prepared next steps means you always have something gentle to start with. The buffer is a form of kindness to future you when energy is low. Keep three ready steps. #ADHD #Planning #ADHDTips #Routines
